info.title: Everyday Meals household API
info.description: Shared API for Android, private GPT Actions and REST-based skills. Household bearer access covers both profiles.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Summary returns lightweight list metadata and scores, without photos, ingredient details or edit revisions. Fetch the meal before editing it.

parameters.name: include_images
parameters.description: False keeps chat responses compact. Fetch a stored photo through the authenticated photo endpoint.

post.description: Log a meal with an analysis already produced in chat, or explicit manual nutrition totals. Provide structured analysis OR description/totals, and one photo source if available. The server recomputes scores and ingredient totals; it does not call another model. Reuse a request_key only to retry the same submission.

post.description: Start server-side photo/text analysis. This can make a paid model request. Returns a persisted draft with status ready or clarify. Never claim a meal is saved until save succeeds.

put.description: Change grams or remove items from a ready draft without another model request. Submit the retained original ingredient indices and positive grams. Omitted items are removed. Totals and dietary score are recalculated from unchanged nutrient densities. To edit an existing meal, first create a draft using source_meal_id and use_existing_analysis=true, then review and save it. Add or identify new foods through clarification text.

post.description: Save a reviewed ready draft. replace_meal_id updates that original meal only when the draft was created from it; otherwise creates a meal. Repeating a successful save returns the saved meal.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Thumbnail is at most 192 pixels; preview uses the current 1280-pixel/200-KiB policy. The stored original is not modified.

get.description: Read body weight in kg; distinguishes it from meal portion weight. Paginated, optionally date-filtered.

Daily or ranged calories, protein/carbs/fat, meal timestamps, personal discipline scores, dietary-pattern score coverage, historical psoriasis scores, and logged body weights. No meals means zero logged intake, not proof of fasting. Dietary scores are app heuristics, not clinical inflammation measurements.
